title: Change in Night Lights between 2012 and 2023 - EIC Version
units: relative night-light change (no numeric scale): -1 lights out .. +1 new lights; years as light / 2012
description: Night lights seen from space, 2012 to 2023: total light on the map grows by about 35 percent (relative pixel brightness; the map has no numeric scale). Rising notes and purple mark places that got brighter, most of all South Asia and Southeast Asia & Oceania; falling notes and orange mark places that got dimmer, such as Western Europe. As the lights spread, the city hum grows and the chorus of birds and insects fades.

legend.meaning: total night light each year, 2012-2023; higher = more light
six longitude sectors west to east, each pitched by its light relative to 2012; panned by longitude
2012->2023 change map swept west to east: rising run = brighter (purple), falling run = dimmer (orange); bigger interval = stronger
Western Europe, Eastern Mediterranean, Ukraine and India, each pitched by its light relative to 2012
louder with more light and with brightening
quiet constant bed, not data-driven here
